scope: Read-only package metadata/source and official public documentation, no Gemini invocation

source_evidence.finding: Registered standalone commands mcp/extensions/skills/hooks/gemma; default positional query launches Gemini. No auth-status subcommand here.
Interactive auth has signin/login and signout/logout; default opens auth dialog. Neither is a read-only nonprompt status interface.
MCP auth is an external-server OAuth path, not Gemini model authentication status.

official_sources.finding: Documents authentication setup and cached credentials, not a standalone local status command.
Documents /auth as an authentication-method dialog; MCP auth concerns MCP servers.

decision: No documented nonprompt nonrequest authentication-status interface found in installed command source and reviewed official pages. Actual authentication remains unknown; do not infer unauthenticated from historical B146 or authenticated from installed package/listing.
next: Keep UNKNOWN unless an explicitly authorized status-only interface or separately admitted runtime check becomes available.
